site.metaTitle: Letterpay | Recommendation emails paid with PayPal
site.metaDescription: AI reads each customer's purchase history and emails the right product at the right time, with the reason. The link opens PayPal checkout directly.
site.imageAlt: Letterpay: recommendation emails paid with PayPal

footer.tagline: Recommendation emails your customers can pay from.

og.subtitle: AI picks the coffee and the day. PayPal takes the payment.

login.heroDescription: Load your purchase history. AI decides who to email, when and with what, and you review every decision in one table.

hero.title: The email is the checkout.
hero.lead: Letterpay reads each customer's purchase history, writes to them when they are about to run out, and explains why this coffee. One tap on the email opens PayPal, with their saved address. No store page in between.

s1.title: AI reads the history
s1.body: For each customer, Claude looks at what they bought, how much and how often, and which emails they opened or paid. It picks the day to write and the coffee to suggest.

s2.title: Code checks the plan
s2.body: Before anything is saved, the plan is checked against your shop: the date is in the future, the coffee is in stock, the quantity is what they usually buy, the price comes from your product list.

s3.title: The link opens PayPal
s3.body: When the customer opens the link, a PayPal order is created at today's price and they land on PayPal checkout. After they approve, the payment is captured and the next email is planned.

owner.title: Every AI decision in one table
owner.body: The console lists each customer with the next email the AI planned: the day, the coffee, the quantity and the reason, next to what happened to the last one. Change the day, coffee or quantity in the table; Letterpay checks your change the same way and rewrites the reason for the new coffee.

guard.title: Built to be welcome in the inbox

consent.title: Only with consent
consent.body: Customers who did not agree to marketing emails are never planned or sent.

pace.title: One next email at a time
pace.body: The AI sets a single next date per customer, and can decide to stop writing to someone who stopped responding.

unsubscribe.title: One-click unsubscribe
unsubscribe.body: Every email has an unsubscribe link that also cancels anything planned.

price.title: No surprise totals
price.body: The email shows the price, shipping and total. Nothing is charged until the customer confirms in PayPal.

demo.title: Try it with Hoshizora Coffee
demo.body: Hoshizora Coffee is a fictional roaster in Japan that sells beans abroad. Sign in, press “Load demo shop” and the AI plans emails for seven customers with different tastes. Demo emails go to your own inbox, and checkout runs in the PayPal sandbox.

finalCta.title: Turn your order history into the next order.
